ssh -i /Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 'cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps && backend/.venv/bin/python -' <<'PY'
import sqlite3,json,re,collections,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps')
db=root/'backend/data/app.db'
audit=root/'.dev/editorial/caption-20261029/audit'
plan=json.loads((root/'.dev/editorial/caption-20261029/plan.json').read_text())
exceptions=json.loads((root/'.dev/editorial/caption-20261029/exceptions.json').read_text())
a=sqlite3.connect(db.resolve().as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
b=sqlite3.connect((audit/'app-before-captions.sqlite').resolve().as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
a.row_factory=b.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
norm=lambda x:' '.join(re.findall(r'\w+',(x or '').casefold()))
groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
for row in a.execute("SELECT p.id,p.caption,pl.slug FROM photo p JOIN place pl ON p.place_id=pl.id WHERE p.status='approved' AND pl.status='published'"):
 if norm(row['caption']):groups[(row['slug'],norm(row['caption']))].append(row['id'])
repeat=sum(len(x)>=3 for x in groups.values())
ids={p['photo_id'] for p in plan['edits']}
assert len(ids)==27
changed={r['id'] for r in a.execute("SELECT id,caption FROM photo") if (prev:=b.execute("SELECT caption FROM photo WHERE id=?",(r['id'],)).fetchone()) and r['caption']!=prev[0]}
assert changed==ids, f'changed_ids mismatch: {len(changed)}'
for p in plan['edits']:
 assert a.execute("SELECT caption FROM photo WHERE id=?",(p['photo_id'],)).fetchone()[0]==p['new_caption']
for e in exceptions['media_exceptions']:
 old=dict(b.execute("SELECT * FROM photo WHERE id=?",(e['photo_id'],)).fetchone())
 new=dict(a.execute("SELECT * FROM photo WHERE id=?",(e['photo_id'],)).fetchone())
 assert new==old,'protected photo changed'
journal=[json.loads(s) for s in (audit/'changes.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if s.strip()]
assert len([x for x in journal if 'photo_id' in x])==27
assert len([x for x in journal if x.get('event')=='postcheck'])==1
assert a.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]=='ok'
assert b.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]=='ok'
assert repeat==0
summary={'published_places':a.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM place WHERE status='published'").fetchone()[0],
'approved_photos':a.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM photo WHERE status='approved'").fetchone()[0],
'changed_photo_captions':len(changed),'repeated_groups':repeat,'protected_identical':len(exceptions['media_exceptions']),
'journal_updates':27,'backup_integrity':'ok','production_integrity':'ok',
'pi_head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()}
print('INDEPENDENT_CAPTION_AUDIT',json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False))
b.close();a.close()
PY
